data.one_liner: Android camera implementation using CameraX library
data.what_it_does: Provides camera preview, image capture, video recording, and advanced features like zero‑shutter‑lag for Android apps. It is an implementation of the core camera plugin that uses CameraX under the hood.
use_when: Building an Android app that requires camera preview and image/video capture
Want custom video output path or persistent recording
avoid_when: Targeting iOS, web, or desktop platforms
Using the generic camera plugin without Android‑specific features
strengths: Uses CameraX for modern Android camera APIs
Endorsed by Flutter, automatically included when using camera
weaknesses: Some limitations: 240p video fallback, streamOptions ignored
Requires WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission for older Android versions
data.setup_notes: No additional setup beyond adding the dependency; permissions are handled automatically, but you may need to add READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE removal if desired.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the same functionality across all platforms and is the endorsed implementation
